title: En el mercado
subtitle: Bargaining at a market
scene: A crafts market. You stop at a stall with woven bags.

lines.en: What can we get you, young man?

lines.es: Uy, está un poco cara. ¿Me la deja en trescientos?
lines.en: Oof, it’s a bit expensive. Would you let me have it for three hundred?
lines.note: ¿Me la deja en…? is the classic market bargaining line.

culture.title: Bargaining
culture.text: Bargaining is normal for crafts at markets, but not for food or in shops with price tags. Stay friendly and smile. A small discount is the usual result.

lines.es: Se la dejo en trescientos cincuenta.
lines.en: I’ll let you have it for three hundred fifty.
